title: Are our cellphones "forcing" us to Mall World?

classification.theory_summary: Speculates that cellphone/online shopping/ads and sleeping near phones may influence recurring Mall World dreams by keeping people in a consumer 'buy mode' and evoking nostalgia/familiarity.
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream episode, locations, events, or sensory/spatial details described—post is speculative/theoretical.

meta.author_theory: Phones are described as a 'mall' (stores/restaurants/entertainment/meeting people) and constant ads/online shopping plus sleeping near phones may influence why people visit 'Mall World' in sleep; author notes Mall World can feel 'nostalgic & familiar' and that they don't always buy things or go there specifically to shop.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains general statements about Mall World dreams (e.g., 'nostalgic & familiar feeling', not always buying/shopping there) but no concrete dream scene to extract into locations/connections/interactions.
